# Commands

<!-- Generated by fzd-docs (tools/commands.py --repo-docs) from fzdbot at origin/dev. Edit the code,
     or tools/commands/fzdbot.toml in fzd-docs, and regenerate; don't edit this file. -->

Every slash command this bot registers, for developers: where it is defined, what it
takes, who may run it, and what it reads and writes. Members' and staff's guides to the
same commands are in the FZD docs.

## Registration

### `/register`

Register for an upcoming event, change your division or team, or withdraw.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/event_register.py:434`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/event_register.py#L434) |
| Usage | `/register` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #scoreboard, and the event channels announced before each event. Admin also: #playground, #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/players/{id}/registrations`; `PUT`/`DELETE /v1/players/{id}/registrations/{event}`; skill questions through `GET`/`PUT /v1/ggp8/players/{id}/evaluations/{event}`. |
| Side effects | The API writes the membership and a registration log row; a withdrawal from a full one-division event promotes the first player on its waitlist. |

## Results

### `/submit`

Submit your result for the slot that just ran, or an earlier one, through a form.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/ggp_submissions.py:551`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/ggp_submissions.py#L551) |
| Usage | `/submit` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #scoreboard, and the event channels announced before each event. Admin also: #playground, #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/events/active`, `GET /v1/events/{id}/schedule`, `GET /v1/players/{id}/results`, `GET /v1/machines` when the event records machines; then `PUT /v1/events/{id}/slots/{slot}/score` or `/time`. |
| Side effects | Sets the player's one `event_results` row for the slot. Posts the confirmation in the channel unless `SUBMISSION_CONFIRMATION_EPHEMERAL` is true. |

### `/submit_inline`

Submit your result in one line, for the slot that just ran or any earlier slot.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/ggp_submissions.py:521`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/ggp_submissions.py#L521) |
| Usage | `/submit_inline <result> [slot] [machine]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #scoreboard, and the event channels announced before each event. Admin also: #playground, #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | API: as `/submit`; `slot` choices read `GET /v1/events/active`, each event's schedule, and the player's registrations when a slot holds a division's vote. |
| Side effects | As `/submit`. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `result` | text | yes |  |  | Your points, or your time like 1:30.44, or dnf |
| `slot` | text | no |  | yes | A slot that has started; left out, the one that just ran |
| `machine` | text | no |  | yes | The machine you raced; needed on an event that records it |

See your results on the running event, or the one that just finished, slot by slot.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/ggp_submissions.py:576`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/ggp_submissions.py#L576) |
| Usage | `/show_submissions` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #scoreboard, and the event channels announced before each event. Admin also: #playground, #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/events/latest`, `GET /v1/events/{id}/schedule`, `GET /v1/players/{id}/standing`. |

### `/delete_submission`

Remove your result from a slot of the running event.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/submissions.py:265`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/submissions.py#L265) |
| Usage | `/delete_submission <slot>` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #scoreboard, and the event channels announced before each event. Admin also: #playground, #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | API: `DELETE /v1/events/{id}/slots/{slot}/result`; `slot` choices as `/submit_inline`'s. |
| Side effects | Removes the player's row for the slot. Posts the confirmation in the channel unless `SUBMISSION_CONFIRMATION_EPHEMERAL` is true. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slot` | text | yes |  | yes | Which slot to clear |

## Scoreboards

### `/fzd_show`

Show the scoreboard of the most recent event, or of the latest run of a weekly event.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/show_scoreboard.py:407`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/show_scoreboard.py#L407) |
| Usage | `/fzd_show [event_type]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #scoreboard, and the event channels announced before each event. Admin also: #playground, #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/event-types?recurring=true` for the choices; `GET /v1/events/latest`, `GET /v1/events/{id}`, `GET /v1/events/{id}/scoreboard`. |
| Side effects | Posts one embed per board in the channel. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type` | text | no |  | yes | Which weekly event to show. Leave it out for the most recent event. |

### `/setup_scoreboard`

Post an event's scoreboard here and keep it current until the event ends.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/show_scoreboard.py:203`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/show_scoreboard.py#L203) |
| Usage | `/setup_scoreboard <event> [group]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Admin |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #fzd-machine, #playground |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/events` for the choices; `GET /v1/events/{id}`, `GET /v1/events/{id}/scoreboard`; `PUT /v1/scoreboards/{message_id}`. |
| Side effects | Posts the board in the channel, registers it in the API's live-board registry, and restarts the refresh loop. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | text | yes |  | yes | Which event |
| `group` | text | no |  | yes | Which division; an event without divisions needs none |

### `/stop_board`

Stop a live scoreboard from updating. Its message stays where it is.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/show_scoreboard.py:389`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/show_scoreboard.py#L389) |
| Usage | `/stop_board <board>` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Admin |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #fzd-machine, #playground |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/scoreboards` and `GET /v1/events` for the choices; `DELETE /v1/scoreboards/{message_id}`. |
| Side effects | Removes the board from the registry; its message stays. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `board` | text | yes |  | yes | Which board |

## Running an event

### `/set_vote`

Record which track a lobby voted for on a race slot.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/votes.py:143`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/votes.py#L143) |
| Usage | `/set_vote <slot> <track> [division]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Admin |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #fzd-machine, #playground |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/events/active`, schedules, `GET /v1/tracks`, `GET /v1/events/{id}` for the choices; `PUT /v1/events/{id}/slots/{slot}/vote`. |
| Side effects | Sets the lobby's vote winner on the slot, replacing any earlier one. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slot` | text | yes |  | yes | Which race slot |
| `track` | text | yes |  | yes | The track that won the vote |
| `division` | text | no |  | yes | The division whose lobby voted; leave empty for an event without divisions |

### `/fzd_start_event`

Obsolete: start an unscheduled 2-hour event now.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/fzdbot/cogs/events_users_handling.py:49`](../src/fzdbot/cogs/events_users_handling.py#L49) |
| Usage | `/fzd_start_event <event>` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Admin |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #bot-workshop, #fzd-machine, #playground |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/event-types` for the choices. MySQL directly: an overlap check on `events_scheduled`, then `INSERT INTO events_scheduled` (`fzd_db.create_event`). |
| Side effects | Creates a 2-hour event with no slots and no scoring. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | text | yes |  | yes | Which event to start. |
